state_machine.scope: Exact lifecycle helpers traced in newer PAL; asynchronous public start also verified in reference and Koikake exports.
state_machine.initialization: Clear remembered64-bit current/stop positions; copy flags16 and filename; graph initializer requests seeking/audio/control/event/sink interfaces, configures renderer window and notification0x8064, applies selected group/master gain, sets phase1 and duration1000ms.
state_machine.running: Render/input thread keeps sampling input and processing graph cancellation. Generic PAL task traversal remains active; Game.exe normal frame callback gates its scene/script updates on IsMovie.
state_machine.cancellation: flags0 mask0x01000001 (Escape/right mouse); nonzero flags mask0x01800007 (adds Space/Return/left mouse). Simultaneous physical Alt+Enter is excluded. Tests push mask, not wheel, held state or arbitrary click.
state_machine.fade_default: Newer init0x100A34F0 stores context[283]=1; reference init0x100A2C20 stores context[277]=1. No config override observed in those init bodies.
state_machine.fade: When context fade gate and custom renderer exist, enter phase2 using engine clock; for elapsed<duration, percent=100-trunc(float32(elapsed)/duration*100), apply live selected group/master gain times percent and renderer alpha=percent/100. Default duration1000ms. Otherwise phase3 aborts immediately.
state_machine.abort_delivery: After fade/immediate abort, Clear input, send media event2 and sleep100ms. IsMovie remains1 until the window event consumer destroys graph.
state_machine.events: Window message0x8064 drains and frees media-event parameters. Events1(complete) and2(userabort) destroy graph and set IsMovie0. Event3(errorabort) destroys with IsMovie1 and attempts recreation; it is not an ordinary clean finish in this native code.
state_machine.cleanup: Stop graph, release filters/interfaces/custom renderer/resource handles, restore cursor state, set IsMovie to cleanup argument, restore render-thread normal priority. Does not delete or replace ordinary script sprite slots.
state_machine.device_reset: Save three fade globals; destroy graph with IsMovie1; rebuild/retry, restore remembered100ns positions if nonzero, Run and restore fade globals.
